description:
Pissikset or Pissis (singular), is a youth subculture based on teenage girls in Finland that emerged during the late 1990s to early 2010s and is related to the Fjortis and Mcbling aesthetic. It is centered heavily on hanging out in city centers or malls, outward appearance, and signaling status through trendy and maximalist accessories, frequently contrasted with male or alternative substyles such as fruittarit (trendy metrosexual boys), metalheads ( Hevarit ) or goths.

It describes the early noughties "bimbo/scene" trends elsewhere, characterized by heavy makeup, a distinct loud style, and a rebellious attitude.
